basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old software engineer based in Singapore with a keen interest in gaming and online trading communities. I spend my evenings and weekends engaging with various online communities, particularly those related to gaming and tech. I enjoy trading virtual items and discussing strategies on games like Adopt Me. I’m not a big fan of automated systems that restrict user interaction, such as cooldown bots. I live with my partner and our cat, Luna. Typically, I am online from 7 PM to midnight during weekdays and more sporadically over the weekend.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the National University of Singapore, my expertise lies in software development and tech innovation. I've developed a strong understanding of online trading systems through personal experience and community engagement in various gaming subreddits.
